name: team-brief
description: Dùng khi cần GIAO VIEC cho tung nguoi trong team marketing hoac chuan bi hop — task cu the, deadline theo gio, definition of done, rang buoc, diem check-in, kem template agenda va bien ban hop lien phong ban co action item. Kích hoạt khi người dùng nhắc 'giao task cho team', 'brief cho nhan vien', 'phan cong cong viec', 'brief 1:1', 'definition of done', 'template hop', 'agenda hop marketing', 'giao viec xong lam sai y'. Không dùng cho — brief tong the ca chien dich thi dung skill brief-chien-dich; duyet output nguoi ta nop len thi dung skill marketing-review; danh gia hieu suat dinh ky thi dung skill team-performance-review; giao viec ra ben ngoai thi dung skill agency-vendor-brief.
